1  PASS AN ORDER WITHDRAWING THE M.C.NO. 1395/2023 PENDING  ON THE FILE OF COURT OF V ADDITIONAL PRINCIPAL JUDGE,
 FAMILY COURT, BENGALURU AND TRANSFER THE SAME TO THE  COURT OF SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE FIRST  -2-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:8874  CP No. 100084 of 2023 CLASS, KUDLIGI FOR FURTHER ADJUDICATION OF THE MATTER TO MEET THE ENDS JUSTICE AND EQUITY.

THIS CIVIL PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER 1.

The above petition is filed by the petitioner/wife seeking for transfer of M.C.No.1395/2023 filed by the respondent/husband pending on the file of the V Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, to the Court of Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Kudligi.
2. The necessary facts for consideration of the present petition are that, the parties married on 18.11.2019 and they have a son from the said wedlock.

The parties were living together in the matrimonial home immediately after their marriage and the wife went to her parents house during 'Ashada month', during which the husband and his family members were informed that the wife was pregnant.
3. It is the allegation of the husband that, even after completion of 'Ashada month', the wife continued to NC: 2023:KHC-D:8874 stay at her parental house and did not come over to the matrimonial home.
After the birth of their son also, the wife did not come over to the matrimonial home and due to various reasons she continued to stay in her parental home.
That despite various attempts having been made to amicably settle the dispute, the same did not yield any results.
4. It is forthcoming that the wife lodged a complaint and the same is registered as Crime No.81/2022 against the husband under Section 498A of IPC, as well as under Dowry Prohibition Act.
Subsequently, the husband has filed M.C.No.1395/2023 which is pending in the Court of the V Additional Principal Judge Family Court, Bengaluru.

entities.text: Additional Principal Judge Family Court, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. It is the contention of the petitioner/wife that, she is dependent on her parents for her livelihood and she is residing along with them at the address mentioned in the cause title.
That the distance between Kudligi and Bengaluru is nearly 290 kilometers and the wife is also required to take care of their minor son.
Whereas, the NC: 2023:KHC-D:8874 respondent is gainfully employed and there is no difficulty for him to prosecute the legal proceedings initiated by him at Kudalgi.
6. The respondent has opposed the transfer of the case as sought for by the petitioner.

sentences.text: 7. I have considered the submissions made by both the parties and perused the material available on record.

8. The facts aforementioned are a matter of record, inasmuch as the petitioner/wife has no independent source of income and she is living along with her aged parents and also taking care of their minor son.
On the other hand the respondent is gainfully employed.

9. In view of the aforementioned and having regard to the settled proposition of law that, in considering the cases of transfer of matrimonial proceedings, the convenience of the wife will have to be given preference to, it is expedient that the relief sought for by the petitioner be granted.
10.
